0 / 留空 = 默认；不支持的家忽略: 0 / blank = default; vendors that don't support this ignore it
0 / 留空 = 默认；不支持的家忽略，实际采样率看出参: 0 / blank = default; vendors that don't support this ignore it — check the output field for the actual sample rate
0 = 没走到 HTTP（网络不通 / 地址解析失败）: 0 = the request never reached HTTP (no network / address resolution failed)
Form=inline 时是 data URL；Form=uri 时是地址: A data URL when Form=inline; a URL when Form=uri
Matryoshka 截断：想要几维（0/留空=模型默认）。1024 维的存储只: Matryoshka truncation: the number of dimensions you want (0/blank = model default). A 1024-dim store takes only a third the storage of 3072 dims, with little quality loss. Vendors that don't support this ignore it — check the output field dims for the actual dimension
audio_seconds（音频秒数）/ token 各家能给几项给几项: audio_seconds / tokens — each vendor provides whichever it can
characters（字符）/ token 各家能给几项给几项，平台按部署的计价: characters / tokens — each vendor provides whichever it can; the platform uses whichever unit the deployment is priced in
inline data URL（平台把字节交给实现）: inline data URL (the platform hands the bytes to the implementation)
inline data URL；MIME 与容器一致（audio/mpeg /: inline data URL; the MIME type matches the container (audio/mpeg / audio/wav)
inline=data URL；uri=上游给的地址: inline = data URL; uri = the URL given by the upstream
inline=平台传字节（data URL）；uri=只给地址，模型自己去取: inline = the platform sends the bytes (data URL); uri = only a URL is given, and the model fetches it itself
len == len(texts) * dims；第 i 条 = flat[i*: len == len(texts) * dims; the i-th entry is flat[i*dims:(i+1)*dims], in the same order as texts
mp3 / wav / pcm16；留空 = mp3。pcm16 由实现裹成 W: mp3 / wav / pcm16; leave blank for mp3. pcm16 is wrapped in a WAV container by the implementation before being returned
normalized_01 = 分数在 [0,1]，可直接与阈值比；unboun: normalized_01 = score is in [0,1] and can be compared directly against a threshold; unbounded = raw logit, can be positive or negative, usable for ranking only; blank = the endpoint didn't say, unknown
query + 候选文本 → 相关度分数（与输入等长同序）: query + candidate texts → relevance scores (same length and order as the input)
zh / en…；留空 = 自动检测: zh / en…; leave blank for auto-detection
一批文本 → 一批向量（与输入等长同序）: A batch of texts → a batch of vectors (same length and order as the input)
上游改写过请求文本时（润色 / 自动生成播报稿）给出；空 = 念的就是请求文本: Provided when the upstream rewrote the request text (polishing / auto-generating a script); empty means the text spoken is exactly the request text
不可用时是原因与下一步；**base_url 填错通常表现为 404 而不是 4: When unavailable, this is the reason and next step; **a wrong base_url usually shows up as 404, not 401** — the message distinguishes the two
与 texts 等长同序: Same length and order as texts
与上游返回同集；顺序按 id 稳定排序: Same set as the upstream response; ordered stably by id
函数参数的形状由调用方定义，是任意 JSON Schema: The shape of the function's parameters is defined by the caller — any JSON Schema
厂商专属参数，形状由上游 API 决定: Vendor-specific parameters; shape is determined by the upstream API
厂商专属参数，形状由上游 API 决定；已有键不覆盖，对象键下钻一层合并: Vendor-specific parameters; shape is determined by the upstream API. Existing keys are not overwritten; object keys are merged one level deep
厂商私有,平台与别家都不解释: Vendor-private; neither the platform nor other vendors interpret it
参数形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: The shape of the parameters is determined by the function's JSON Schema and is only known at runtime
各家自己的音色 id；留空 = 这家的默认音色: Each vendor's own voice id; leave blank for that vendor's default voice
同 chat，但边生成边产出增量: Same as chat, but produces deltas as it generates
实现**真正**施加了哪个口径；空 = 没施加（这家没这个概念，或这个模型不支持: Which purpose the implementation actually applied; empty = none applied (this vendor has no such concept, or the model doesn't support it)
平台据此判断能力降级与 failover: The platform uses this to decide on capability degradation and failover
平台的 canonical 请求（模型名已解析为上游真名）: The platform's canonical request (the model name has been resolved to the upstream's real name)
形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: The shape is determined by the function's JSON Schema and is only known at runtime
拿这条凭证问一次上游「有哪些模型」，给部署编辑的模型名下拉用: Uses this credential to ask the upstream for its model list once, for the model-name dropdown in the deployment editor
拿这条凭证问一次上游的模型列表，验证 key 与 base_url 都对: Uses this credential to fetch the upstream's model list once, verifying both the key and base_url are correct
按 canonical 请求调用上游模型，返回完整回答: Calls the upstream model with the canonical request and returns the complete answer
某语音合成模型可选的预置音色；custom=true 表示可 / 需自由填写（音: The preset voices some TTS models offer; custom=true means free-form input is allowed / required (voice cloning, voice design, compatibility gateways)
模型产出的图 / 音频等（inline=data URL，uri=地址）；只在请: Images / audio etc. produced by the model (inline = data URL, uri = URL); only appears when the corresponding output modality was requested
由平台路由填入: Filled in by the platform's routing
由平台路由填入；TEI 那类一进程一模型的实现会忽略它: Filled in by the platform's routing; implementations like TEI, where one process serves one model, ignore it
由调用方给出，形状随其业务而定: Provided by the caller; its shape depends on the caller's business logic
结构化输出的结果，形状由调用方给的 JSON Schema 决定: The result of structured output; its shape is determined by the JSON Schema given by the caller
给识别器的上下文 / 专有名词；不支持的家忽略: Context / proper nouns for the recognizer; vendors that don't support this ignore it
自建 OpenAI 兼容网关接入（one-api/OpenRouter/自建反代: Connects to a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway (one-api / OpenRouter / a self-built reverse proxy…). The thinking dialect can be overridden per deployment.
自然语言的语气 / 情绪 / 角色描述，不会被念出来；不支持的家忽略: A natural-language description of tone / emotion / character — it is not spoken aloud; vendors that don't support this ignore it
要念的文本；风格标签（如 (开心) / [笑]）算文本的一部分，原样透传: The text to speak; style tags (e.g. (happy) / [laughs]) are treated as part of the text and passed through as-is
识别出的语种；空 = 上游没说: Detected language; empty = the upstream didn't say
请求的推理语义被就近执行时的一句提示（如 GLM-5.3 家族关不掉思考）；空: A note shown when the requested reasoning semantics were approximated instead (e.g. the GLM-5.3 family can't turn off thinking); empty = executed faithfully
这批文本要拿来干什么：retrieval_document（被检索的一方）/ r: What this batch of texts will be used for: retrieval_document (the side being retrieved) / retrieval_query (the side issuing the retrieval) / similarity / classification; leave blank to not declare. Retrieval models treat queries and documents differently — getting it wrong won't error, but recall will suffer
部署级透传给上游的额外 body 字段，形状由上游 API 决定: Extra body fields passed through to the upstream at the deployment level; shape is determined by the upstream API
音色复刻的样本音频（inline data URL）；只有支持复刻的模型认它: Sample audio for voice cloning (inline data URL); only recognized by models that support cloning
